summary: CivicGuard AI - A full-stack civic tech web app for reporting civic issues (garbage, violations, tobacco spit, public nuisance) with AI-powered image/video analysis, auto-complaint generation, privacy features (face/plate blur), status tracking, gamification (civic scores, badges, leaderboards), educational content (daily quiz, facts, stories, videos), helpline integration, heatmap dashboard, volunteer marketplace, RTI generator, and multi-language support (Hindi + English). Mobile-first dark modern UI with scalable backend for Smart City integration.
architectural_notes: Full-stack web app with REST API architecture
Role-based access control: Citizen, Authority, Admin
AI services: image/video analysis, face/plate detection, complaint generation, fake report validation, predictive analytics
Mobile-first responsive design with dark theme
Secure cloud storage with scalable backend
Integration points: helpline services (112, 1969, 103), municipal APIs
Gamification engine: scoring, badges, leaderboards at city/school levels

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system with role-based access control supporting three roles: Citizen, Authority, and Admin
Create image upload functionality with automatic location and timestamp tagging for civic issue reporting (tobacco spit, garbage, traffic violations, public nuisance)
Implement video upload functionality supporting 30-90 second videos for civic issue reporting with automatic location and timestamp tagging
Implement one-tap helpline integration supporting 112 (emergency), 1969 (traffic police), and 103 (ambulance) with automatic city municipal contact detection based on user location
Create complaint status tracking system with four states: Received, Under Review, Action Taken, and Escalated, allowing users to view current status and status history of their reports
Implement anonymous reporting option that allows users to submit complaints without revealing their identity while maintaining report functionality
Build real-time civic heatmap dashboard displaying geographic distribution of reported civic issues with color-coded intensity based on report frequency
Implement area-wise civic score calculation system that generates cleanliness and discipline index scores for different geographic areas based on report frequency and resolution rates
Create gamified civic score system with user badges and city-level and school-level leaderboards to encourage civic participation
Build volunteer and NGO task marketplace where organizations can post civic improvement tasks and volunteers can browse and accept assignments
Create RTI (Right to Information) draft auto-generator that helps users create properly formatted RTI requests based on their civic complaints
Build before/after impact proof generator that allows users to submit follow-up images showing issue resolution and creates visual comparison documentation
Implement multi-language support for Hindi and English throughout the entire application including UI text, notifications, and generated documents
Create daily 5-question civic quiz feature with simple multiple-choice questions about civic responsibility, scoring system, and result display
Implement daily civic fact feature that displays one educational fact each day in simple language about civic responsibility, cleanliness, or good citizenship
Create daily moral story feature that presents one short story each day with positive messages about responsibility, cleanliness, and good citizenship in simple language
Implement motivational video section featuring age-appropriate motivational content for mature audiences in user's selected language (Hindi or English)
Create tobacco spit-free public report section with dedicated reporting interface and awareness messaging about health and cleanliness impacts of tobacco spitting

Design and implement mobile-first dark modern UI with clean layout, easy navigation, and consistent dark theme throughout the application that emphasizes cleanliness, responsibility, and good citizenship
